'''LB's Garage''' is a garage owned by [[LB]] located in [[Playa Del Seville]], [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]], in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

It is first used in [[Home Invasion]] where at the end of the mission the [[Boxville (3D Universe)|van]] used to rob the house is parked in the garage. The garage is used in [[Burglar|burglary missions]], where the player has to park the van in the garage at the end.
